description: Search active US civil aircraft registrations by owner name, make/model, exact manufacturerModelCode or engineManufacturerModelCode, serial number, state, aircraft type, airworthiness class, manufacture-year range, or Mode S (hex) code. Discover codes with faa_search_aircraft_types and get full records with faa_lookup_registration. Filters are AND-combined and at least one is required. Owner-name search is available on deployments that expose owner PII. Responses report totalCount across all pages and return nextOffset when more matches remain.

aircraftType.description: FAA aircraft type code: 1–9, H (Hybrid Lift), O (Other), exact match. Trimmed and uppercased; blank is unset.

airworthinessClass.description: FAA airworthiness class code, exact match: 1 Standard, 2 Limited, 3 Restricted, 4 Experimental, 5 Provisional, 6 Multiple, 7 Primary, 8 Special Flight Permit, 9 Light Sport. Trimmed; blank is unset.

engineManufacturerModelCode.description: Exact FAA engine manufacturer/model code: five digits such as 17026, trimmed; blank is unset. Leading zeros are significant. Take it from faa_lookup_registration or a search result.

limit.description: Requested page size (positive integer, default 25); requests above 200 are clamped.

makeModel.description: Aircraft make or model. Each search term matches a token prefix, such as 172 matching 172S, and hyphenated and joined designators match each other, such as PA28 and PA-28. A search adds up to 20 spelling variants, in term order; a term whose variants exceed what remains matches as typed.

manufacturerModelCode.description: Exact FAA manufacturer/model/series code: 6–7 alphanumeric characters, trimmed and uppercased; blank is unset. Discover codes with faa_search_aircraft_types. AND-combined with other filters.

modeSCode.description: Six hexadecimal characters for the Mode S code (ICAO 24-bit address), exact match. Trimmed and uppercased; blank is unset. When nothing matches, the notice says which N-number a US address encodes and encodedNNumber carries it for faa_get_registration_status.

offset.description: Zero-based index of the first result to return — pass the nextOffset from a previous response, with identical filters, to page forward (default 0).

ownerName.description: Registrant name to match (full-text). Rejected when owner-PII redaction is on.

serialNumber.description: Exact manufacturer serial number, trimmed and matched case-insensitively. Leading zeros, punctuation, and internal spaces are significant. Blank is unset. Use manufacturerModelCode or makeModel to narrow duplicate serials.

state.description: Two ASCII letters for a state, territory or military postal code (e.g. WA, GU, AE, AP; exact match). Trimmed and uppercased; blank is unset.

yearManufacturedMax.description: Latest year manufactured, inclusive (four-digit year). Registrations with no recorded year never match.

yearManufacturedMin.description: Earliest year manufactured, inclusive (four-digit year). Registrations with no recorded year never match.

name: faa_search_registrations

dataAsOf.description: Source date of the FAA registry snapshot, YYYY-MM-DD.

encodedNNumber.description: N-number the searched modeSCode encodes, such as N399WM. Present only when nothing matched and the code is a US address from A00001 to ADF7C7; check it with faa_get_registration_status.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `mirror_loading`: The FAA registry mirror has a refresh that has not completed. `invalid_code`: manufacturerModelCode is not 6–7 alphanumeric characters after normalization. `invalid_state`: state is not two ASCII letters. `invalid_mode_s_code`: modeSCode is not six hexadecimal characters. `invalid_aircraft_type`: aircraftType is not 1–9, H or O. `invalid_engine_code`: engineManufacturerModelCode is not five digits after trimming. `invalid_airworthiness_class`: airworthinessClass is not one digit from 1 to 9. `invalid_year_range`: yearManufacturedMin is later than yearManufacturedMax. `owner_search_disabled`: ownerName was supplied while owner-PII redaction is enabled on this deployment. `no_filters`: No search filter was supplied. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

nextOffset.description: Offset for the next page, when more matches remain.

notice.description: Refresh, limit, or search guidance when applicable.

registrations.description: Matching registration summaries for this page (up to limit).

items.description: A decoded registration summary; use nNumber with faa_lookup_registration for full detail.

code.description: The raw code as stored in the FAA registry.

label.description: The decoded human-readable label; omitted when the code is unrecognized.

airworthinessClass.description: Airworthiness class (Standard, Experimental, …) as code + label.

code.description: The raw code as stored in the FAA registry.

label.description: The decoded human-readable label; omitted when the code is unrecognized.

engineManufacturerModelCode.description: FAA engine manufacturer/model code (five digits); pass it as engineManufacturerModelCode to find registrations with the same engine.

manufacturerModelCode.description: FAA manufacturer/model/series code (6–7 characters); use with faa_get_aircraft_type for specs or manufacturerModelCode to find registrations of the same type.

modeSCodeHex.description: Mode S code in hex (ICAO 24-bit address).

nNumberDisplay.description: N-number with the leading "N" for display.

ownerName.description: Registrant name; present only when owner-PII redaction is off.

ownerRedacted.description: True when owner name was withheld by the redaction gate.

serialNumber.description: Manufacturer serial number as stored by the FAA.

code.description: The raw code as stored in the FAA registry.

label.description: The decoded human-readable label; omitted when the code is unrecognized.

shown.description: Number of results on this page when truncated.

totalCount.description: Total matches across all pages. Always present.

truncated.description: Present and true when more matches remain.

title: faa-aircraft-registry-mcp-server: search registrations
